Change this file to start a rehearsal of .github/workflows/release-odaddin.yml (it builds and checks the add-in package and uploads it as a
run artifact; it publishes nothing) when the change you want to test is outside the paths that workflow watches.

Rehearsals so far:
1. First Windows run: got through restore from GitHub Packages and failed on the missing OpenAvalon local feed directory.
2. Second run: restore and SDK 11 selection fine; Stride.Editor failed with CS0101 (EmbeddedGameForm defined by both the WinForms and the
   headless variant on a Windows host).
3. This run: with the headless twin guarded by !STRIDE_EDITOR_WINFORMS.
4. Third run: the CS0101 was gone; Stride.Editor's Windows variant (EmbeddedGameForm.cs) failed with CS1061 because the fork typed Host as
   IEmbeddedGameHostView, which has no ForwardMessage. Now it calls it through GameEngineHost, the Windows host.
5. Fourth run: Stride.Editor compiled on Windows; Stride.Assets.Presentation failed with CS0111 (EditorGameController.DragDrop.Headless.cs
   defines DisableDrop/DoDragDrop/EnableDrop that the Windows twin also defines). It was the second and last *.Headless.cs file in the
   tree without the !STRIDE_EDITOR_WINFORMS guard.
6. Fifth run: the drag-drop twin compiled; EditorGameController.cs (Windows branch) failed with CS1061, ActualWidth/ActualHeight are not on
   IEmbeddedGameHostView. It now reads them from the interface's Visual (the same element on the Windows host).
